name: Aoi Kyouka
source:
Kyouka is [url=http://vndb.org/c2048]Kurou[/url]'s live-in assistant and sex buddy, but she acts more like a feisty slave. She waits on him hand and foot, obeying his every command and sexual whim, being constantly insulted, but also occasionally striking back with a physical attack.

[from [url=http://www.somethingawful.com/d/hentai-game-reviews/idols-galore.php]Something Awful[/url]]
